data: What is the approximate value of the Euclidean distance of the pink line at timestep 10,000?

The question asks for the approximate value of the Euclidean distance of the pink line at timestep 10,000. From the caption, we know that the pink line corresponds to k = 5e-3. The figure shows two graphs: one for training loss on the target task and another for knowledge forgetting from the source tasks. The relevant graph for this question is the second one, which measures the Euclidean distance.

Looking at the graph, the pink line (k = 5e-3) appears to be around the 6 mark on the y-axis at timestep 10,000. Therefore, the approximate value of the Euclidean distance of the pink line at timestep 10,000 is 6.
